answer: Each identity grows on a trellis: a lattice of stranger-signed work edges, one new rung per epoch, timed by a dawn clock that cannot be wound forward, so a fresh clone starts at the ground and climbs for epochs before it earns. Payout flows only along a trellis whose roots reach the dawn beacon. One slash sends a ripple down the whole lattice, and every clone sharing a funding root loses its stake at once. N clones pay n trellises and n dawn waits, yet one ripple burns them all, while one honest agent climbs once and keeps the harvest.
